question: Yesterday you investigated why the synthesis subagent in your multi-agent research system drops citations from web search results. You did this work in a Claude Code session that you named citation-loss-investigation. No code in the research system has changed since then, so the earlier analysis is still valid. Today you want to continue that exact investigation. What should you do?

options.text: Start a fresh session and have Claude explore the coordinator and subagent code again from the beginning.
options.reason: Full re-exploration discards valid prior context, while --resume continues the named session that already holds this analysis.

options.text: Use fork_session on yesterday's session to create a new branch, and then continue the investigation in that branch.
options.reason: fork_session creates independent branches to explore divergent approaches from a shared baseline, not to simply continue one investigation.

options.text: Start a fresh session and inject a structured summary of yesterday's findings before you continue the investigation.
options.reason: Starting fresh with an injected summary is the better choice when prior tool results are stale, but here no code changed and the prior context is valid.

options.text: Run Claude Code with --resume citation-loss-investigation so that the named session continues with its earlier context.
options.reason: Named session resumption with --resume <session-name> continues a specific prior conversation, and resumption fits when the prior context is mostly valid.
